title: Tea Lights 24-Pack – Battery-Powered LED Candles in Warm White
seo_description: 24 battery-powered LED tea lights in warm white. The same amount as a bag of real candles, but without an open flame in the room.
descriptionHtml:
Worrying about the lit candle you forgot to blow out

A real candle means someone has to remember to blow it out before everyone goes to bed, before the cat jumps up on the table, before you leave the room to answer the phone. That brief hesitation in the doorway – is it still burning in there? – is a feeling you'd rather be rid of completely.

24 candles that glow without an open flame

The pack has 24 battery-powered LED tea lights in warm white – the same number as a whole bag of real candles, but without a single flame to keep an eye on.

Features

  • 24 candles in a single pack – enough for the dinner table, the windowsill and the hallway all at once.
  • No flame to blow out or forget – the LED candles glow without open fire in the room.
  • Warm white glow like real candles – the light is warm white instead of the cold bluish white many LED candles have.
  • Battery-powered – no cords at the table – move the candles wherever you like without an outlet nearby.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
